title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.30771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the communit

translated_title: GameDojo：在电子游戏中对实时交互智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 交互式智能要求智能体能够基于观察采取行动，并适应行动带来的后果。研究这些能力需要在可控条件下提供多样化且具有挑战性的任务。我们推出了GameDojo，这是一个可控制的交互式游戏玩法基准，涵盖20款游戏中的120个Boss战斗场景，用于评估模型能力、学习算法和智能体框架。编码智能体重构游戏环境并编写游戏脚本，生成了包含600小时游戏轨迹的GameDojo-Data数据集。实验表明，前沿模型面临巨大挑战，尤其是在实时交互方面。在GameDojo-Data上训练使GameDojo-4B达到了前沿模型的性能水平，并在实时性能上表现最为突出。我们还发现联合训练可以提升单个任务的表现，且学习到的策略能够在不同Boss之间迁移。这些发现共同确立了GameDojo作为一个具有挑战性且富有价值的交互式游戏玩法基准，服务于整个研究社区。
tldr: GameDojo是一个涵盖20款游戏120个Boss战的可控交互式游戏基准，基于其600小时数据的GameDojo-4B模型达到了前沿性能，尤其在实时交互方面表现最强。
en_tdlr: GameDojo is a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark spanning 120 boss encounters across 20 games, and training on its GameDojo-Data enables GameDojo-4B to reach frontier performance with the strongest real-time interaction capabilities.
